description:
Read one clause by its key, with where it sits and what sits beneath it.

Use it when a search result points at another clause, or when you need the whole
of an article rather than the part that matched. The call is recorded, with the
key that was read rather than a question.

as_of.description: Read the clause as it stood on this date
as_of.title: As Of

key.description: A canonical key, such as gdpr:art-17:para-1
key.title: Key

lang.description: Which language to prefer, as a two letter code
lang.title: Lang

whole_subtree.description: Also return this clause and everything beneath it in reading order, which is what you want for a whole article
whole_subtree.title: Whole Subtree

name: get_clause

Clause.description: One clause, and what it takes to check it.

archived.description: True for a clause of a policy the organisation has archived, which no longer applies. Say so when citing it
archived.title: Archived

authoritative.description: Whether this language is the one that prevails in law
authoritative.title: Authoritative

breadcrumb.description: Where the clause sits, outermost first
breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb

citation.description: One line naming the clause, its version and its date
citation.title: Citation

in_force_since.description: The date this version took effect
in_force_since.title: In Force Since

jurisdiction.description: Null for an organisation's own policy
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

key.description: The canonical key a citation points at
key.title: Key

obliges.description: False for text that explains without obliging, such as a recital
obliges.title: Obliges

prevailing_text.description: For a clause shown in translation, the text that prevails, word for word
prevailing_text.title: Prevailing Text

prevails.description: For a clause shown in translation, the language whose text prevails
prevails.title: Prevails

source_url.description: Where the text was taken from, for a law
source_url.title: Source Url

text.description: The clause as it stands, word for word
text.title: Text

trust_tier.description: verified when a named maintainer checked the pack against the official source, community when it passed validation only, null for an organisation's own policy
trust_tier.title: Trust Tier

Clause.title: Clause

outputSchema.description: One clause, where it sits, and what sits beneath it.

children.description: The clauses directly beneath this one
children.title: Children

cross_references.description: Keys this clause's own words point at
cross_references.title: Cross References

formerly.description: Set when this key named a different rule in the policy's version before
formerly.title: Formerly

now.description: For a policy's clause read in a version that is no longer in force, where the same rule is in the version in force. A policy's keys follow its printed numbers, so the rule may have another key now
now.title: Now

subtree.description: This clause and everything beneath it in reading order, when asked for
subtree.title: Subtree
